value_proposition: Capture context, find answers, and automate tasks with AI built for your team.

observed_facts.fact: Notion serves 100 million users in over 50 countries.
Over 50 percent of YC companies use Notion.
62 percent of Fortune 100 companies use Notion.

analytical_insights: Notion leverages Next.js for its frontend framework and Cloudflare for infrastructure management.
The platform heavily emphasizes AI capabilities and automated agents as a core value proposition.
Notion has established strong enterprise and startup adoption, including partnerships or usage across Fortune 100 companies and Y Combinator startups.
